constraints: Preserve pale cream earth pony, wavy dark-purple mane and tail, sky-blue eyes, black rectangular glasses, green-blue/yellow-red four-square flank insignia. No horn, wings, embedded text, UI or content-card assets. Ultra-wide 3:1 illustration.

prompts.practice: Practice page: this exact pony is seated at a wooden work desk on the LEFT 42% of a wide panorama, thoughtfully working on a laptop with its forehooves resting naturally on the desk, cozy plant-filled studio, tall windows with Shanghai skyline, books and warm afternoon sunlight. Match top-middle concept panel composition: scene and character on left, quieter shaded room on right 45% for overlaid website text.

Match top-right concept panel composition, preserve quieter shadowed LEFT 45% for text.

Match bottom-left concept panel, quieter dark RIGHT 45% for text.
